findings.text: the generated service is an endless loop (the emitted command passes no --once, so imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2849 hands run() iterations=None) under a one-hour walltime with no --requeue, no array and no resubmission path anywhere in the tree: SLURM kills the job at the limit and nothing starts the next pass, so the store stops being maintained an hour after each manual --submit -- measured by running the reviewed code's own --dry-run, whose header carries --time=01:00:00 and whose exec line reads agent ingest --record receipts --index idx.sqlite3.

the dry-run test asserts the script's placement but never its embedded --record/--index, and the dry-run plus --once tests both stub the seam that would carry them: with --record and --index removed from generate_ingest_script in a scratch copy of the reviewed head, all four tests still pass (4 passed, EXIT=0), so a regression that makes the submitted service ingest and write a different store than the submitter chose passes the suite silently, which is the property slurm.py:1084 claims for the script.

the docstring says record_dir and index_path are embedded as absolute paths, but the CLI resolves them with Path(...).expanduser() and no .resolve() (imas_ambix/agent/cli.py:2811-2816), so a relative --record is emitted verbatim and the submitted job resolves it against whatever working directory SLURM gives it -- measured: --dry-run --record receipts --index idx.sqlite3 prints an exec line carrying --record receipts --index idx.sqlite3, and only the non-exec echo line names the same relative target.

follow_ons: imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:1102 -- the generated service pairs an endless loop with a one-hour walltime and no restart path; whether the ingest should instead be run with --once under a scheduler's repeat, or the service requeued, is a scheduling decision the plan defers to the coordinator.

the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite or after_suite, so reckon.crew.review.annotate_review_of_run reports this store's added-failure count as unmeasured against that manifest; the measured values are the two arms stored on this record.
